description: This source file implements the core functionality for hashing objects in Git. It includes functions for hashing files, standard input, and providing command-line interface logic for the 'git hash-object' command.

methods.name: void hash_fd(int fd,const char * type,const char * path,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Hashes a file descriptor by reading its contents and adding it to the Git object database, then prints the object ID in hexadecimal.

methods.name: void hash_object(const char * path,const char * type,const char * vpath,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Hashes a file from its filesystem path, opening the file and passing its descriptor to hash_fd.

methods.name: void hash_stdin_paths(const char * type,int no_filters,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Reads file paths from stdin, unquoting if necessary, and hashes each referenced object.

methods.name: int cmd_hash_object(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command handler for 'git hash-object', parsing options and invoking hashing functions accordingly.
